name: onboard
description: The onboarding app (shruggr/skein#90, #113), installed in the host skein. POST /onboard/call {fn: "onboard.create", args: {handle, image?}} over any BRC-104 session asks the host's instance manager for a skein owned by the caller's key; POST /onboard/register {username, identityKey, signature} (open; signed over "register <username>@<domain>") asks it for a mailbox instance for the key. Each handle is certified through the host's certifier and recorded under onboard/handles/<handle>, and the app serves BRC-169 from those records (/onboard/manifest.json, /onboard/resolve, /onboard/search, the paymail PKI at /onboard/bsvalias/id/) with the holders' signed profiles (POST /onboard/profile). onboard.adopt (the host skein's owner) records and certifies a mailbox instance made before. config.onboard.domain is the host's one handle domain.
